A new Civiqs analysis tracking 117,851 registered voters shows once-reliable territory now looking far less certain, raising questions for Republicans ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.

results.title: Donald Trump’s State Approval Map Has a Midterm Warning

results.content:
Only eight states give Trump an approval rating above 50% in the latest Civiqs tracking data. His approval is highest in Wyoming at 57%, followed by North Dakota at 56% and Oklahoma at 54%. Hawaii gives him his lowest rating at 19%.

Nationally, the same tracker places Trump at 36% approval and 59% disapproval.
